# ankra_application (Resource)

An application: a Git repository Ankra builds, packages and deploys. The counterpart of `ankra application add` and `ankra application delete`, plus `ankra application credential set` and `ankra application registry set|clear`, which change an existing application in place. Destroying it deletes the application and tears down every deployment of it on every cluster. Deploy it to a cluster with `ankra_application_deployment`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_application" "web" {
  name                     = "web"
  app_repo_credential_name = "github-main"
  app_repo_owner           = "acme"
  app_repo_name            = "web"
  app_repo_branch          = "main"

  # Publish to the organisation's own Harbor instead of Ankra's registry.
  image_registry = {
    url                   = "oci://harbor.acme.dev/apps"
    credential_name       = "harbor-push"
    admin_credential_name = "harbor-admin"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_repo_credential_name` (String) Name of the organisation's GitHub credential the repository is reached through. Changes in place.
- `app_repo_name` (String) Repository name. Changing it replaces the application.
- `app_repo_owner` (String) Repository owner or organisation. Changing it replaces the application.
- `name` (String) Application name, unique in the organisation. Changing it replaces the application.

### Optional

- `app_repo_branch` (String) Branch Ankra builds and deploys. Defaults to `main`. Changing it replaces the application.
- `image_registry` (Attributes) Container registry the application publishes to, when it is not the organisation's own Ankra registry project. Changes in place; removing the block hands the application back to the organisation's registry project. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--image_registry))

### Read-Only

- `container_image_url` (String) Image repository the application's builds publish to.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the application.
- `state` (String) Lifecycle of the application record: `creating` while onboarding runs, `up` once it is complete, `error` when onboarding failed. It says nothing about whether a deployment is running.

<a id="nestedatt--image_registry"></a>
### Nested Schema for `image_registry`

Required:

- `url` (String) Registry project as `oci://<host>/<project>`.

Optional:

- `admin_credential_name` (String) Registry credential with project administrator rights, which lets Ankra mint the application's own push robot.
- `api_url` (String) Registry management API base, `http://` or `https://`.
- `component_repositories` (Map of String) Repository inside the project for a component, keyed by component name.
- `credential_name` (String) Registry credential of the organisation that authenticates to it.
- `flat_repositories` (Boolean) Publish monorepo components as `<project>/<component>` instead of `<project>/<app>/<component>`. Defaults to `false`.
- `manage_actions_secrets` (Boolean) Whether Ankra writes `credential_name` into the repository's Actions secrets. Needs `credential_name`. Defaults to `false`.
- `password_secret_name` (String) Repository Actions secret holding the registry password.
- `project_public` (Boolean) Ask for the project to be public when Ankra creates it. The platform does not report it back, so a change made outside Terraform is not detected. Defaults to `false`.
- `pull_secret_name` (String) Name of the dockerconfigjson Secret the generated manifests reference.
- `username_secret_name` (String) Repository Actions secret the build logs in with.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Applications are imported by id.
terraform import ankra_application.web 5b0c4a9e-2f43-4b8e-9a51-1f0d8e7c2a10
```
